federationSettingsId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the federation that you linked the newly created organization to.

orgOwnerId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the MongoDB Cloud user that you assigned the Organization Owner role in the new organization.

skipDefaultAlertsSettings.description: Disables automatic alert creation. When set to true, no organization level alerts will be created automatically.

ApiKeyUserDetails.description: Details of the Programmatic API Keys.

desc.description: Purpose or explanation provided when someone created this organization API key.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this organization API key assigned to this project.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

privateKey.description: Redacted private key returned for this organization API key. This key displays unredacted when first created.

publicKey.description: Public API key value set for the specified organization API key.

roles.description: List that contains the roles that the API key needs to have. All roles you provide must be valid for the specified project or organization. Each request must include a minimum of one valid role. The resource returns all project and organization roles assigned to the API key.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization.

isDeleted.description: Flag that indicates whether this organization has been deleted.

links.description: List of one or more Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) that point to API sub-resources, related API resources, or both. RFC 5988 outlines these relationships.

name.description: Human-readable label that identifies the organization.

skipDefaultAlertsSettings.description: Disables automatic alert creation. When set to true, no organization level alerts will be created automatically.

CloudAccessRoleAssignment.description: MongoDB Cloud user's roles and the corresponding organization or project to which that role applies. Each role can apply to one organization or one project but not both.

groupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project to which this role belongs. You can set a value for this parameter or `orgId` but not both in the same request.

orgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization to which this role belongs. You can set a value for this parameter or `groupId` but not both in the same request.

roleName.description: Human-readable label that identifies the collection of privileges that MongoDB Cloud grants a specific API key, MongoDB Cloud user, or MongoDB Cloud team. These roles include organization- and project-level roles.

CloudAccessRoleAssignment.title: Role Assignment

href.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that points another API resource to which this response has some relationship. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

rel.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that defines the semantic relationship between this resource and another API resource. This URL often begins with `https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/atlas`.

OrgServiceAccount.description: Organization Service Account that Atlas created for the organization.

clientId.description: The Client ID of the Service Account.

createdAt.description: The date that the Service Account was created on. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

description.description: Human readable description for the Service Account.

name.description: Human-readable name for the Service Account.

roles.description: A list of Organization roles associated with the Service Account.

items.description: Organization roles available for Service Accounts.

secrets.description: A list of secrets associated with the specified Service Account.

createdAt.description: The date that the secret was created on. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

expiresAt.description: The date for the expiration of the secret. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the secret.

lastUsedAt.description: The last time the secret was used. This parameter expresses its value in the ISO 8601 timestamp format in UTC.

secret.description: The secret for the Service Account. It will be returned only the first time after creation.
